result.summary: Detected 2 visual issues: low text contrast on the promo banner and text truncation on restaurant cards.

issues.description: White text on the light mint promotional banner suffers from insufficient contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or use a darker font color to meet readability standards.

issues.description: The third restaurant title under 'Fastest near you' is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...').
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line wrapping or adjust font size to avoid clipping restaurant names.
